correctness.rationale: The signed permutation symmetry averaging preserves every eligible projection onto invariant cut or cycle spaces. Origin stabilizer invariance and zero divergence force every invariant circulation to vanish, so unique equivariant projections are the orthogonal cut/cycle complements. The exact product heat kernel factors the electrical potential; absolute edge gradients sum to 2(q-1)/q along the distinguished coordinate and (q-1)/q along each other coordinate. Rank and edge transitivity give the common diagonal 2(q^d-1)/(d(q-1)q^d), hence the exact complementary norm. The analytic argument covers all integers d>=2,q>=3. Independently computed complete reduced-Laplacian rational matrices passed 88,858 exact assertions in nine finite calibration and new-range cases; these checks do not substitute for the proof.

value.rationale: The 2023 all-Hamming uniqueness theorem left explicit norm values evaluated for the binary case only. The result classifies the two complementary relative projection constants for the natural nonbinary two-parameter family exactly, identifies simultaneous optimal projections, proves a strict cut-versus-cycle inequality, and exhibits exact linear growth with alphabet-dependent slope. Neither finite brute force nor trivial substitution into a previously known all-q norm formula suffices.
